## Professional Profile

I am pursuing an **M.Sc. in Management and Digital Technology at the Technical University of Munich, Campus Heilbronn**. My experience spans data analytics and process automation at Mercedes-Benz, digital business systems and UAT, as well as finance and controlling.

My focus is using data, automation, and technical tools to simplify complex business processes and create measurable improvements.
